Signature.purpose: One node of the pipeline diagram: a stage, a queue, the clock or Telegram
Signature.description: A queue shows its depth and a dead-letter chip that turns red when there are any; a stage shows its count. Pressing it selects it. Text wraps rather than truncates.

button.class: w-full h-full min-w-0 text-left rounded-box border p-3 flex flex-col gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 motion-safe:active:scale-[0.98] {node.selected ? 'border-primary bg-base-200' : 'border-base-200 bg-base-100 hover:border-base-content/30'} {node.alert ? 'ring-1 ring-error/60' : ''}

span.class: flex items-start gap-2 text-sm font-medium leading-tight
